records.name: First service grant
records.content:
define LoadClient as adapter with zpr.adapter.cn:'finance-client'.
define LoadService001 as service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:'echo-service'.

provide LoadService001 at load-service-001.svc.zpr over TCP 10000.
  allow LoadClient.
records.summary: Illustrative first grant only; generate and install the complete runtime layer before running the scenario.
